lines.text: We found a shipment in the Colossus. The hold was still sealed. Then the shooting started, and I had to get my people out. There's another crew in there now. They say we abandoned it.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [measured, matter-of-fact] We found a shipment in the Colossus. The hold was still sealed. Then the shooting started, and I had to get my people out. There's another crew in there now. They say we abandoned it.
lines.direction: State the setback plainly. Do not imply what the shipment contains.

lines.text: There's no manifest in the file.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [composed, questioning] There's no manifest in the file.
lines.direction: A short observation; let the missing manifest matter without accusation.

lines.text: Our handlers have it. Eighteen thousand to get them back into the yard and cover the inspection. If Morrow can be repaired, another twenty-two to bring the parts in and cover my fitters. The militia have the road beyond the yard. That stays their job.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION

lines.text: Receiving store first, then the workshop. My militia will follow you in. Cover our two technicians at Morrow's southern service access while they inspect her. Watch the south haul road; that's how the other crew has been getting in.
